### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **3** package(s): `@objectstack/core`, `@objectstack/objectql`, `@objectstack/types`, touching **10** documentable anchor(s).

**5** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/api/error-catalog.mdx`  _(via DuplicateRecordError (symbol, a top-level class), UNIQUE_VIOLATION (literal, a string literal in a comment on a changed line))_
- `content/docs/data-modeling/drivers.mdx`  _(via UNIQUE_VIOLATION (literal, a string literal in a comment on a changed line))_
- `content/docs/protocol/kernel/error-handling.mdx`  _(via DuplicateRecordError (symbol, a top-level class), structuredCodeAnswer (symbol, a top-level function), UNIQUE_VIOLATION (literal, a string literal in a comment on a changed line))_
- `content/docs/protocol/kernel/http-protocol.mdx`  _(via UNIQUE_VIOLATION (literal, a string literal in a comment on a changed line))_
- `content/docs/protocol/kernel/i18n-standard.mdx`  _(via fieldLabel (symbol, a field of class DuplicateRecordError))_

⛔ **4** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-3.mdx`  _(via UNIQUE_VIOLATION (literal, a string literal in a comment on a changed line))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-4.mdx`  _(via UNIQUE_VIOLATION (literal, a string literal in a comment on a changed line))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-5.mdx`  _(via UNIQUE_VIOLATION (literal, a string literal in a comment on a changed line))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-6.mdx`  _(via UNIQUE_VIOLATION (literal, a string literal in a comment on a changed line))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **55** of **207** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **41** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 4049efa34584a18485ccd13efcf4351f509205eb` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `2cafc35c5f64e834177d3ee3272a3b2224804523` — the merge of head `f87980e52e4ddde7cb6c5f9448c6d31bf44ce185` into base `4049efa34584a18485ccd13efcf4351f509205eb`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 2cafc35c5f64e834177d3ee3272a3b2224804523 && git checkout 2cafc35c5f64e834177d3ee3272a3b2224804523
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 4049efa34584a18485ccd13efcf4351f509205eb f87980e52e4ddde7cb6c5f9448c6d31bf44ce185 && git checkout -B drift-repro 4049efa34584a18485ccd13efcf4351f509205eb && git merge --no-ff f87980e52e4ddde7cb6c5f9448c6d31bf44ce185

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 4049efa34584a18485ccd13efcf4351f509205eb
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 4049efa34584a18485ccd13efcf4351f509205eb` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `f87980e52e4ddde7cb6c5f9448c6d31bf44ce185`
Local-runs: none

Face: the `Clause-②: yes (widening)` declaration alone (no `packages/spec/src/**` path, no governed path, no narrowing arm). Inputs: card #26867 with every comment (triage `6452099314`, claim `6452673647` and its amendment `6454768714`, the `os-dev-report`s), the PR body and file list, the net diff against `main`, and the check-runs on the head.

### ① Derived judgments

1. **`DuplicateRecordError.fieldLabel`** (`@objectstack/objectql`, exported from the package entry `src/index.ts:209`): a new optional `readonly` property, set only when the conflicting field resolves to a display label in the writer's locale. Additive: no existing member changes type or meaning, and absence means "no label in hand". **Right**, and it is the widening the declaration names.
2. **`envelopeUniqueViolation(error, object, schema?, messages?)`**: a new optional fourth parameter, and every in-repo engine write door passes the write's message context. The function is module-level in `duplicate-record-error.ts`, and `src/index.ts` does not re-export it (seat grep of the entry: only `DuplicateRecordError` and `DUPLICATE_RECORD_CODE`). No external caller can reach it through the entry. **Right**, not on the published surface.
3. **Wire body of `409 UNIQUE_VIOLATION`**: `error` names the field by its label when one is in hand, else the generic sentence. `field` (API key), `code` and status are unchanged. `developerMessage` reads the labels in the writer's locale (byte-identical when no i18n service or translation exists). No accept set narrows: the same requests succeed and fail. The text change is not a contract, because the card names `field` as the programmatic key and the changeset tells clients to read `field`. **Right.**
4. **`sanitizeRowError`** (`@objectstack/core`): a unique refusal now answers the generic sentence instead of the driver's column identifier. The dev measured that `column` is the API key, so this is the same defect, and `toFailedResult` adopts the door's verdict first. **Right.**

### ② Semver level

`patch` on `@objectstack/types`, `@objectstack/objectql` and `@objectstack/core`. `Metadata-protocol: none` (no metadata key an author writes moves), so the level follows that kind alone: `patch`. The changeset and the PR body both carry `Clause-②: yes (widening)` and `Metadata-protocol: none` at line start (changeset fixed in `f87980e5`, PR body corrected by the seat). **Right.**

### ③ Boundary flags

- File surface beyond the claim's named files (the objectql producer, a docblock, three rest wire pins, the checklist row): this is the standing "fix at the producer" order, named in the PR body and recorded in the claim amendment `6454768714`. Accepted.
- Object label in `developerMessage` now also locale-resolved: one resolution feeds both labels of the sentence, and it is byte-identical without translations. Accepted.
- Out of scope, carried in Acceptance notes: the English sentence frame around a translated label; two dated measurement tables that quote the old sentence as history. Neither is a defect this diff introduces.
- `open_questions`: none.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-26867-unique-refusal-label`
Reviewed-by: `session_01QSeKYmQXM3rHJcPnrEPk4B`

**VERDICT: PASS**

- **申报更正:** the seat's claim declared `Clause-②: no`. The producer-side fix adds `fieldLabel` to the exported `DuplicateRecordError`, so the seat amended the claim (`6454768714`), corrected the PR body, and had the changeset line fixed (`f87980e5`, one line).
- **契约复核:** `TIER_DEFAULT` record `6454812968` (declaration face): PASS.
- **前提实测:** both sentences at `data-error-classification.ts` (L1149, L1781) and `import-runner.ts:370` read on `origin/main` by the seat at claim and by the dev. The locale reading moves the fix to the producer: `mapDataError` has neither locale nor label, and the engine exit has both.
- **测试 / 抽查:** new and updated pins assert `code` + status + `field` + sentence (label, no-label, zh-CN and untranslated-locale cases on 4 doors). Four ablations were recorded, each restored to the HEAD blob, two of them with `ablation-dist-preflight` dist legs. The dogfood pin passes 5/5 at the merge head. Gates: 72 / 72 exit 0. `f87980e5` is prose-only.
- **Seat read of the diff:** the label comes from the existing `resolveFieldLabel` / `objectDisplayLabel` ladder, with no second lookup. The REST arm uses `fieldLabel` only when it is a non-empty string, else the generic sentence. `field` keeps the API key.
